sources.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein: open weights, 5.6B parameters
sources.snippet: In internal evaluations, FLUX 3 Image Klein ranks first in text-to-image, multi-reference generation and image editing, ahead of larger open weights models. It also rates above the closed models in the comparison, Ideogram V4.5 and FLUX.2 [pro].
